title: 企鹅的鹅卵石求婚与考拉的指纹

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! This is our twenty-fourth show! Today we meet a penguin that proposes with a pebble, and a koala whose fingerprints look exactly like yours. A builder from Antarctica, and a fingerprint star from the treetops. Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！这是我们的第二十四期节目啦！今天我们要认识一只用小石头"求婚"的企鹅，还有一只指纹和你的几乎一模一样的考拉。一位是来自南极的建筑师，一位是树梢上的指纹明星。出发吧！

blocks.en: Our first hero lives in Antarctica, the coldest place on Earth. It is the Adélie penguin, a bird in a black-and-white garment that looks like a suit. In spring, the males arrive first. They do not bring flowers. They bring pebbles! A male picks up a smooth stone in his beak and walks to a female, with courage. If she likes his stone, she may place it in her nest. It looks like a proposal! Scientists watch from a boat, its engine humming softly.
blocks.title: 企鹅的鹅卵石求婚
blocks.cn: 我们的第一位主角生活在南极——地球上最冷的地方。它就是阿德利企鹅，一种穿着黑白"礼服"、看起来像西装的鸟。春天一到，雄企鹅最先到达。它们不带花。它们带小石头！一只雄企鹅用喙叼起一块光滑的石头，鼓起勇气走向一只雌企鹅。如果她喜欢他的石头，就可能把它放进自己的巢里。这看起来就像求婚！科学家们坐在一艘小船上静静观看，小船的发动机发出轻柔的轰鸣声。

blocks.en: But the pebble is not just a pretty gift. It is the primary building material of the nest. The pair builds a round nest of stones, and the nest keeps the eggs safe and dry. When snow melts, the water runs between the stones instead of flooding the nest. Sharp ice could wound a chick's soft feet, so a dry nest matters. So the male is really saying, "Look, I can build a safe home!" Sometimes a male steals a stone from a neighbour's nest, and a fight erupts!
blocks.title: 企鹅的鹅卵石求婚
blocks.cn: 但这块小石头可不只是一件漂亮的礼物。它是筑巢的主要建筑材料。这对企鹅用石头筑起一个圆圆的巢，巢能让蛋保持安全和干燥。积雪融化时，水会从石头缝里流走，而不是淹进巢里。锋利的冰面可能会划伤雏鸟柔软的小脚，所以一个干燥的巢非常重要。于是雄企鹅其实是在说："看，我能建一个安全的家！"有时候，一只雄企鹅会从邻居的巢里偷一块石头，于是就打起来了！

blocks.en: To everyone's delight, the pair works together, taking turns on the eggs and fetching more stones. Their footprints fade in the snow, but their little stone nest stays. A penguin's proposal is not about a diamond ring. It is about teamwork and a safe place for babies to grow.
blocks.title: 企鹅的鹅卵石求婚
blocks.cn: 让所有人高兴的是，这对企鹅随后一起合作，轮流孵蛋、轮流找石头。它们的脚印消失在雪地里，但它们的小石头巢留了下来。企鹅的"求婚"与钻石戒指无关。它关乎合作，以及一个能让宝宝们安全长大的地方。

blocks.en: Our second hero is the koala, a grey furry animal from Australia. It sleeps most of the day in a eucalyptus tree, holding on tight. By coincidence, a scientist who was holding a koala looked closely at its fingers — and got a big surprise. Under the soft flesh of its fingertips were tiny ridges, loops, and whorls. They looked just like human fingerprints!
blocks.title: 考拉的指纹
blocks.cn: 我们的第二位主角是考拉，一种来自澳大利亚的灰色毛茸茸的动物。它一天中的大部分时间都在桉树上睡觉，紧紧抱住树干。巧合的是，一位抱着考拉的科学家仔细看了看它的手指——结果大吃一惊。在它指尖柔软的肉里，有细小的纹路、箕形纹和斗形纹。它们看起来简直和人类的指纹一模一样！

blocks.en: The scientist studied the prints under a microscope, and the surprise grew bigger. Even experts could hardly tell a koala's print from a human's! How can this be? Humans and koalas are not close cousins at all. Yet both grew the same kind of skin on their fingers. Scientists call this convergent evolution: two different animals solving the same problem in the same way.
blocks.title: 考拉的指纹
blocks.cn: 科学家在显微镜下研究这些纹路，惊讶更甚。连专家都几乎分不清考拉的指纹和人类的指纹！这怎么可能呢？人类和考拉根本不是近亲。然而，它们的手指上却长出了同一种皮肤。科学家把这叫做趋同进化：两种不同的动物，用同样的方式解决同一个问题。

blocks.en: For the koala, the grip is everything. Its ridges help it hold smooth branches and pick soft leaves, like your fingerprints help you hold a pencil. So when you press your finger on a window, imagine a koala doing the same in a tree. Two hands, two worlds — and almost the same print!
blocks.title: 考拉的指纹
blocks.cn: 对考拉来说，抓握就是一切。它的纹路帮助它抓住光滑的树枝、摘取柔软的树叶，就像你的指纹帮助你握住铅笔一样。所以当你把手指按在窗户上时，想象一下，一只考拉正在树上做着同样的事。两双手，两个世界——指纹却几乎相同！

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: "like two peas in a pod." Peas in one pod look the same! So when two people are always together, we say they are like two peas in a pod. Listen: Pip and Pop are two penguin chicks. They waddle together, nap together, and lose their feathers on the same day. "You two are like two peas in a pod!" laughs their mother.
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是"like two peas in a pod"（像豌豆荚里的两颗豌豆）。同一个豆荚里的豌豆看起来一模一样！所以当两个人总是在一起时，我们就说他们像豌豆荚里的两颗豌豆。听这个小故事：Pip 和 Pop 是两只企鹅宝宝。它们一起摇摇摆摆地走路，一起打盹，还在同一天换掉羽毛。"你们俩真像豌豆荚里的两颗豌豆！"它们的妈妈笑着说。

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories. A penguin builds a nest stone by stone, and a koala's fingers carry prints like ours. Two questions. First: what gift would you bring to ask a friend to build with you? Second: what do your fingerprints help you do? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事。企鹅一块石头一块石头地筑巢，考拉的手指上带着和我们一样的纹路。两个问题。第一：如果你想请一位朋友和你一起搭建东西，你会带什么礼物去？第二：你的指纹能帮你做什么？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Remember: a small stone can start a family, and your fingers carry a wonder like a koala's. Stay curious, and keep exploring. See you tomorrow morning!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里，小小探险家们。记住：一颗小石头可以开启一个家庭，你的手指上也藏着一个像考拉一样的奇迹。保持好奇心，继续探索吧。明天早上见！

quiz.title: B. 单项选择（Single Choice）
questions:
What does the male penguin bring to the female?
A. Flowers
B. A smooth stone
C. A fish
D. A feather

Why is the pebble nest important?
A. It looks beautiful
B. It keeps the eggs safe and dry
C. It keeps the penguins warm
D. It stops other birds from coming

What surprised the scientist about the koala?
A. It sleeps all day
B. Its fingerprints look like human fingerprints
C. It can swim very fast
D. It eats only leaves

What does "like two peas in a pod" mean?
A. Two people who are always together and look alike
B. Two peas in a garden
C. Very small
D. Very hungry
